Care &Craftsmanship

Expert services for collectors, families and estates, backed by nearly four decades of experience.

i. — Appraisal

Know the true value

We provide detailed, independent valuations for insurance, estate planning, division of assets or simple curiosity. Each report includes photographs, an assessment of condition, the object's history and current market comparisons.

  • Written reports accepted by major insurers
  • Home visits for large collections and estates
  • Free verbal opinion for walk-in items on Saturdays
FromRs 5,000per item
Book an AppraisalBook an Appraisal
ii. — Restoration

Restored with patience

Our workshop uses traditional techniques: French polishing, gilding, clock servicing, porcelain repair and upholstery. We always conserve first and only restore where needed, so each piece keeps its original character.

  • Clock & watch movements serviced and regulated
  • Furniture repair, French polishing and re-upholstery
  • Gilded frame and porcelain conservation
FreeEstimateon inspection

iii. — Consignment & Estates

Find the right new owner

Whether it's a single heirloom or a whole house, we can help. We research, photograph and present your pieces to our network of collectors at home and abroad, and we handle everything with discretion.

  • Transparent commission with no hidden fees
  • Professional photography and catalogue listing
  • Complete estate clearance and sensitive handling
